name: Scoriaceous-Cwm
description: Bare rock from pole to pole, shaded in grays, ox-blood reds, and pale magnesium white. The regolith records four billion years of bombardment, scarred through by towering mountain ranges near the terminator.

With no air to speak of, silence is total, broken only by whatever touches your boots. The horizon stays razor-sharp at any distance. Mats of pigment-bearing microbes stain the wet stone in bands of rust and violet.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
For traders, titanium alone justifies the crossing; for everyone else, the planet pays in questions. Fuel is cheap, information is not, and both are dangerous to carry.
